description: Add a section of a given `type` (keys of get_site.theme.sections) to a page, optionally from one of its presets, with a settings patch and a 0-based position (default: the end). Sections hold blocks; add them with add_block.

page_id.description: Page id, e.g. home, menu, about, loyalty

preset.description: Start from one of the type's presets

settings.description: Settings as a JSON merge patch (null removes a key). get_site lists each type's settings.

name: add_section
title: Add section
